__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness (not authored in frontmatter).

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed; always true for a valid artifact.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading — one property per template section; the value is the raw Markdown under that heading. Authored artifacts may add or omit sections, so this is advisory (additionalProperties is permitted) and no section is individually required.

Impact.description: Who is affected and how severely (quantified where possible).

Root cause.description: Five-whys / fishbone result from the problem-solving workshop.

Target artifact.description: For workflow improvements: the skill / instruction / prompt / orchestrator file to change.

Derived backlog items.description: Features or Stories created from this pain point (product improvements).

Related pain points.description: Cross-references to other pain points that share a systemic cause.

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact (everything after the frontmatter), injected by the harness.

title.description: Human-readable title of the pain point.

status.description: open | triaged | resolved | converted | accepted | duplicate

origin.description: Where the pain point was first observed.

layer.description: Organizational layer at which the pain point lives.

symptom.description: Short statement of the observed friction.

resolution.description: How the pain point is resolved.

targetArtifact.description: File path or artifact id targeted by a workflow improvement.

derivedFeatures.description: Feature ids created from this pain point.

derivedStories.description: Story ids created from this pain point.

owner.description: Role accountable for resolving the pain point.

workItemRelations.description: Typed work-item relations (dependsOn / enables / relatedTo / supersedes).

github.description: GitHub Projects sync envelope, filled by portfolio/_sync (null when authoring).
